paper.title_en: Holographic spin alignment of vector mesons in heavy ion collisions
paper.abstract_en: We give a brief review on holographic description of spin alignment for vector mesons in strongly coupled QCD matter. Within a spectral–function framework, the spin density matrix of a vector meson is related to the in-medium current–current correlator, which we compute using gauge/gravity duality. Then we introduce the spin alignment of vector mesons in plasmas with and without magnetic fields. In particular, we find opposite signs of ($\rho_{00}^{\mathrm{H}}-1/3$) for light strange mesons and heavy charmonium, providing a strong-coupling explanation for the qualitatively different global spin alignment of $\phi$ and $J/\psi$ measured in heavy-ion collisions.
